bluf: Rise at Seven is a UK search first content marketing agency, with offices in Manchester, London and New York, that sells SEO, digital PR, social search and AI visibility to enterprise retail, travel and finance brands and claims 79 global awards. The record shows it moving its case studies onto social search and AI search (cases dated 2026-08-25 and 2026-09-08) and publishing steadily, 19 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days. A rival should know it sells AI visibility with no llms.txt and no audited product, lists no pricing, has no paid media line at all, and 8 of its 15 clients on record are names only.
doing:
The positioning line reads: search first content marketing agency of organic media planners building category leaders through SEO, digital PR, social search and AI visibility. In plain words, an SEO and digital PR shop that calls its output organic media and has extended it to social search and AI answers. The headline claim, 79 global awards and counting including Best Large Search Agency at the Global Search Awards, is quoted as a claim; neither that award nor the PR Week award for best PR agency outside London carries a year.

The sold mix leads with Content & Digital PR (score 3: digital PR teams across the UK, US and Europe) and SEO (score 3: the onsite SEO page cites the Global Search Awards win). Scoring 2: AI Search / GEO (an AI SEO agency page on becoming the most cited brand in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity), B2B & ABM (a B2B page plus the Dojo, Magnet Trade and Tool Tester cases) and Creator & Influencer (social search cases for grocery and debt brands). Data & Measurement scores 1; every paid, commerce, CRO, email, web and AI automation line scores 0, breadth 6. The record lists no partners; the proprietary assets are The Category Leaderboard and the Multi-Channel Search Report; the services list adds international digital PR (US, Spain, Germany, Netherlands, Italy, France).

Its AI posture is offsite: AI visibility and GEO sold by engineering entity signals and citations, with a 2026-09-03 blog post calling brand consistency the biggest open goal in AI search; no audited AI visibility product (tracking, scorecard, citation share) shows in the record. Moves, news and jobs lists are all empty and no ATS is recorded: the record holds no dated corporate move. It lists no pricing model. Conspicuously absent for an agency of its kind: any paid media line, any web or CRO line, a founding year, a headcount and an owner.
clients:
The record describes an enterprise client type across retail and fashion, travel, B2B, financial services, beauty and pharmacy and health retail, UK home market, New York office. The book on record is 15 clients, 7 observed and 8 names only, all from case studies; the newest cases, dated 2026-08-25 and 2026-09-08, name no client (a US grocery retailer taken to pos 1 on social; the debt category through social search).

Observed, all on cases dated 2025-05-23: SIXT, organic demand (N1), an extra 3m clicks regionally through SEO; Magnet Trade, organic and B2B pipeline (N1, N11), a full service SEO case credited with a 170%+ increase; Dojo, B2B pipeline (N11), a B2B story for Dojo card machines; Tool Tester, B2B pipeline (N11), 1500+ links; Parkdean Resorts, AI and organic (N9, N1), the cases Dominating Google and AI search and Social search and multi channel content to #1; ClubMed, coded leads (N10), The Most Pinned Staycation Locations; Raisin, PR (N12), digital PR in multiple markets for a finance leader.

Names only: JD Sports (its excerpt reads 65% up YoY in clicks for JDSports FR, IT, ES, an organic signal the read does not code), Preply, Pooky, Trouble Maker, Taylor & Hart (a haribo ring slug), Revolution Beauty, Lloyds Pharmacy and PrettyLittleThing; needs inferred from the SEO and digital PR lead.

Three clients sit on other tracked books: Preply with kaizen, jbh and junto; Parkdean Resorts with iprospect; ClubMed with np-digital.

As a judgment tied to the edition, this retail, travel and finance base is likely to ask next for provenance led social search and citation share in AI answers (KJ8, human provenance as a distribution signal; KJ1, the citation replacing the click), moderate confidence.
house: Say and do runs 3 of 4. Corroborated: LinkedIn advertising (19 ads, all company page; samples read Most brands are investing in the wrong places, and See how real people search and how your brand fits into the journey), Publishing cadence (the sitemap lists 340 URLs, 19 updated in 90 days and 54 in 365, with blog posts dated 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-25) and Creator & Influencer (Instagram, TikTok and YouTube channels linked from the site). Contradicted: AI Search / GEO, the gap the Radar flags, since it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt while 10 AI topic URLs sit in its sitemap; no AI crawlers are blocked. The Transparency Center shows 1 Google ad under Rise At Seven Limited, text, last shown 2026-02-13, 0 in the last 30 days. Tags are GA4, Google Ads and a Meta pixel; no CMS was detected, no test tools, no ABM stack; the Meta and TikTok libraries were not read.
market:
The Horus read is Favored, index 22.7, 77th percentile. Best placed for KJ8, human provenance becomes a distribution signal, driven by Creator & Influencer (2) and Content & Digital PR (1), with KJ1 a second tailwind through AI Search / GEO (2); most exposed to KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out, driven by SEO and Content & Digital PR. The sold mix sits at 16:51 on the Solar Arc (Atum); best fit The Toll Road at 54/100; resilience 26.7, integrity 75. It is making P2 (entity work alongside its SEO line), partial on P1, unknown on P5, absent on P6 and P7; P3, P4 and P8 do not apply with no local or paid line.

Monsoon reads Breeze at 48.5, 23rd percentile: migration 51 against displacement 46, 51 of it from the sold mix, SEO (21) and Content & Digital PR (13) carrying most movable hours. Footprint inferred, no hub office or onshore claim; work would go 65% to South and Southeast Asia, 20% to Eastern Europe, 15% to Africa and the Maghreb; automation overlap 0.0.
openings: Lead with the AI visibility contradiction: it sells becoming the most cited brand in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, yet publishes no llms.txt and shows no audited AI visibility product (citation share, scorecard, tracking) on record, so a rival leading with an audited citation number is likely to win that comparison, moderate confidence; the falsifier is a Rise at Seven llms.txt or a published citation scorecard at the next compile. Second, the missing half of the funnel: with Paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic & CTV, Retail Media, CRO and Web & Product all scored 0, any client that wants organic and paid search planned together must buy the paid half elsewhere, so an integrated search offer is very likely to contest its enterprise retail and travel accounts, moderate confidence. Third, KJ6 exposure: the sold mix leans on SEO and digital PR hours, the ones the hollowing middle removes, with no owned audience hedge or agent operator depth on record. The contestable accounts are Preply (also with kaizen, jbh and junto), Parkdean Resorts (iprospect) and ClubMed (np-digital), plus the 8 names only rows with no described work. No public pricing: transparent outcome pricing is a conversation it cannot hold.
watch: Indicator I6, platform AI labeling enforcement after the EU Article 50(2) deadline, next reading 2 December 2026: new reach penalties for unlabeled AI personas or engagement would strengthen KJ8, the judgment Rise at Seven is best placed for.

Indicator I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: search and other growth below 10% flags cannibalization, above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and bears on KJ1.

Indicator I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk behind its social search cases.

Indicator I7, holiday 2026 agentic checkout volume and merchant opt out rates, next reading December 2026 to January 2027: disclosed AI checkout GMV or high Shopify opt out rates would move KJ4 for its retail book.

The dated moves to follow up are the 2026-08-25 US grocery retailer and 2026-09-08 debt category social search cases and the 2026-09-25 blog post: a named client or a citation share figure on either case would change the observed count.
The next Radar compile after 2026-09-28 refreshes offices, ads, sitemap cadence and clients; an llms.txt, a CMS detection, a headcount or a dated move would fill the blanks in this record.
